result.summary: The application interface is generally well-structured, but there is one significant text overlap issue in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: The title 'Trattoria Piccol' is partially obscured or cut off in the 'Fastest near you' carousel at the far right edge, which might indicate a layout sizing issue for long titles.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or font size for the title container within the restaurant card to ensure the full name is visible or use an ellipsis (...) instead of abrupt truncation.

issues.description: The distance text '25-35 min' in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar entry is slightly cramped by the preceding UI elements, affecting visual hierarchy.
issues.suggestion: Increase the horizontal margins or padding around the delivery time tag to improve readability.
